one_liner: An all-in-one platform for sales funnels, email marketing, online courses, and affiliate management.
access_notes: Developers can create an account on the free plan and generate public API keys instantly from the account settings.
verdict_reason: Systeme.io provides a self-serve free tier, fully documented REST API endpoints, API keys generated in settings, and an official MCP server implementation.

evidence.snippet: API keys are unique identifiers that authenticate requests to our public API. They enable you to programmatically access and manage various resources on our platform.
The all-in-one Systeme.io platform offers a free plan and three paid plans: Startup, Webinar, and Unlimited.
For technical details, please refer to our official MCP documentation:
Programmatically create new webhooks to receive real-time notifications, retrieve lists of your existing webhooks, and remove webhooks that are no longer needed.
